title: Which Kotter Step Is This?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Classify eight leadership actions from one school's change effort by the Kotter step each carries out.

learningObjectives: The learner will classify eight leadership actions by the Kotter step each carries out, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Kotter's eight steps, from the section "Kotter: From Urgency to Anchoring" in Chapter 17.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: The vision is repeated at every staff meeting, in newsletters, and at family nights. Which step?
The district fixes the login problem that blocked teachers. Which step?
commonMisconceptions: Steps can be done in any order
Communicating the vision is a single announcement
A win means the change is finished
assessmentOpportunities: The vision is repeated at every staff meeting, in newsletters, and at family nights. Which step?
The district fixes the login problem that blocked teachers. Which step?
Does a short-term win mean the change is finished?
Is communicating the vision a single announcement?

controls.name: 8 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the steps; two tries per action.

controls.name: Show definitions
controls.description: Opens a table of the steps and their meanings.

controls.name: Previous missed, Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the items for a practice run.
